question: What frequency of observance suffices for attaining the designated stage?
premises: Observance may occur at three junctures.
Observance may occur at only one juncture.
inference: Attainment of the stage is possible through observance at three junctures or alternatively at only one.
uncertainties: Whether bhūmiṃ denotes a spiritual level or a physical realm is context-dependent.
plain_english: One obtains that stage by observance at the three junctures, or indeed at only one.
